Answer

ADK is implemented. LangChain, LangGraph, and A2A are proposed alternatives or extensions with different responsibilities.

  1. Inspect current call sites before claiming guarantees.
  2. Keep proposed integrations separate from implemented behavior.

What would remote specialist work add?

Diagram structure
  • Authorized review request request
  • Minimal delegated task delegate
  • Independent specialist remote
  • Validate returned artifact validate
  • Local authorized decision decide
  • delegate → remote · A2A proposed
  • remote → validate · artifact
  • request → delegate · scoped
  • validate → decide · recommendation

This second workflow is a design exercise. No remote task, graph checkpoint, or generated approval replaces the local confirmation transaction.
